item.title: Version 3.0.1
item.description:
A polish release focused on Passage mode: lookups land where you're reading, the whole window moves where you want it, and long passages don't force you to scroll past the breakdown to see the translation.

What's new

  • Source line breaks are preserved in Passage mode — dialog turns, paragraph splits, and multi-line subtitles render on their own rows instead of flow-wrapping together.
  • Click any word in a captured passage for an inline popup with its pinyin and definition — no more scrolling to a definitions list at the bottom.
  • English translation pinned at the top in Passage mode so long passages don't require scrolling past the breakdown.
  • Live mode is off by default on new captures. Click the Live toggle for subtitles and other live-updating content.
  • Popups are now draggable — grab any empty area of the header to move the window.
  • Pronounce button added to the hover popover's header row.

Fixes

  • Fixed a stuck translation spinner in Live mode where silent rescan ticks were invalidating in-flight translations.
